## Activity

During December 2025, Central Eye Clinic completed 217 captures. Activity was recorded for the month as part of routine site operations. The service continued to submit images for review, with the available capture volume supporting the grading process.

## Image quality

There were 6 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 2.8 per cent. This indicates that most submitted images were suitable for assessment, although the ungradable captures should continue to be monitored through routine quality review. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

A total of 63 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 2 days. This provides a summary of the time between image submission and completion of grading during December 2025. The site should continue to monitor grading turnaround and image quality as part of normal operational oversight.
